method: One warmup, randomized paired allocator order, warm filesystem cache. GQ post_parse_compute_ms excludes parsing/startup/publication. Native commands use complete process wall time. Peak RSS is whole child process. Exact GQ semantic/work results, native data tables, replay files and ingest bytes are checked. Each pair supplies one speed ratio; percentile bootstrap CI uses resampling of paired median ratios, not independent samples. Serial GQ decoding is the release default; no allocator tuning or C malloc interposition.

summary.negative_term_semantics: not observed in the selected retained archive evidence unit; not biological absence
summary.omitted_middle_placement_semantics: when a junction chain represents more than two distinct reads with two span-extreme placements, an unobserved aligned-block predicate is unknown
summary.multimapper_alternative_semantics: only uniquely mapped chain evidence is inspected; multimapper records and alternatives are excluded
summary.umi_class_identity: the default molecule_record evaluates only uniquely mapped, locus-resolved archive records for a barcode-corrected cell and exact raw UMI value; archive-wide exact raw-UMI-value-class union is explicit because same-value collisions can combine distinct physical molecules; one-mismatch UMI edges are not collapsed
summary.placement_quantifier_semantics: any/all evaluate the complete expression on each retained placement independently; all is non-vacuous; omitted unique geometries make geometry-sensitive unwitnessed any or unrefuted all unknown; junction paths are invariant within a retained chain; pattern masks remain record-level marginal observations
